plan.name: Example: Primary school renovation and extension

scoreRule.perElementType: mean of each required parameter real-value percentage
scoreRule.rowPercent: round(100 * elements whose value is real / elements of the type)
scoreRule.score: round(mean of the row percentages); 100 when nothing is required

placeholders.note: A value is trimmed first. It is not real when it is empty, equals one of the requirement placeholders (ignoring case) or matches "always". Otherwise it must match valueRule.pattern (ignoring case, anywhere in the value).

tableRule.normalize: lowercase; remove spaces, underscores and hyphens; drop everything from the first "("
tableRule.category: a row belongs to the first element type, in file order, whose categoryNames include the normalized Category cell; rows that match none are ignored. Exception: see split

split.rule: Applies only when the table has a column named in columns.Function. A row whose normalized Category cell is in cells is placed by revitWhere: it takes the first element type, in file order, whose revitWhere.revitCategory is this category and whose conditions all hold. A condition reads the column named for it (wallKind: the normalized cell turned into a kind through wallKindValues, any other non-blank family is wallKindOther); a condition whose column the table lacks is skipped, and a type whose conditions are all skipped takes no rows. A cell is normalized and compared with the normalized in values; a blank or unknown cell does not hold. A row that takes no element type is not covered by the plan: it is counted, not scored. With no Function column every such row follows the category rule.

tableRule.column: a requirement reads the first column whose normalized header is in its columnNames; with no such column every element fails it

kind.from: the wall's family name: Basic Wall, Curtain Wall, Stacked Wall; any other family is a wall modelled in place

structural.note: A second axis, not a kind: report structural and non-structural walls as two counts inside interior and exterior walls. modelRules.statement: No two elements of the same category share a value of the listed parameter.
The model has no more than 100 Revit warnings.
No two identical instances sit in the same place.
The model has one set of grids, with no duplicate grids.
The model has one set of levels, with no duplicate levels.
At least 95% of the model elements are associated with a level.
Every model uses the worksets listed.
Every model has a named 3D export view, used for milestone exports.
The model has no in-place families.
No CAD file is imported into the model; CAD files are linked.
At least 95% of the model elements carry a real material; the names listed do not count as a material.
Elements of the listed category are modelled only in the listed discipline's model; other models show none.
Every view name follows the view naming rules of this plan.
No more than 20% of the views are left off sheets.
Every project parameter has a value on at least one element.
No element sits more than 3000 mm below the lowest level or above the highest level.
